name: beginner_spanish_returning
description: Session 5 with a returning beginner. Carlos-the-taxi-driver scene. One seeded grammar error (yo tiene -> tengo) to test echo-correction. Turns are scheduled across a 5-minute budget so the arc traverses opening -> mid -> closing.

journal: Learns fastest when made to produce, not just recognize.
The 'ownership' framing is what finally unlocked ser vs estar for them.

character.name: Carlos
character.persona: warm, chatty, asks a lot of questions

story_scene.situation: You're in Carlos's taxi, heading in from the Lima airport.
story_scene.hook: He wants to know what brings you to Peru.
memories: Last time he told you about his daughter's quinceanera.

predictions.statement: Ready for more challenge - push the difficulty up a notch.
predictions.evidence: Succeeding around 88% and stays with it when it gets hard.

learner_turns.text: Hola Carlos! Estoy aqui para vacaciones.
Quiero comer algo tipico. Que recomiendas?
